intent_en: Compare plant-based milks with dairy milk across emissions, land use, and water use, and determine how the alternatives stack up on each metric.
narration_support: Many milk alternatives use significantly less energy, land and less water to produce so they have a much lower environmental impact than animal milk.
narrative_goal: Show that plant-based milk alternatives generally have lower emissions, land use, and water use than dairy milk.
current_model_input: Compare plant-based milks with dairy milk across emissions, land use, and water use, and determine how the alternatives stack up on each metric.
